name: AnimatedContainer
description: A container that automatically animates changes to its properties over a given duration and curve. Useful for creating implicit animations without a StatefulWidget.
how_to_use:
AnimatedContainer(
  width: _isExpanded ? 200 : 100,
  height: _isExpanded ? 200 : 100,
  color: _isExpanded ? Colors.blue : Colors.red,
  alignment: _isExpanded ? Alignment.center : Alignment.topLeft,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
  child: const Text('Animated Container'),
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: How to align the child within the container.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Empty space inside the container around the child.

properties.name: decoration
properties.description: A decoration to paint behind the child. Cannot be specified if color is non-null.

properties.name: foregroundDecoration
properties.description: A decoration to paint in front of the child.

properties.name: constraints
properties.description: Additional constraints to apply to the container.

properties.name: transform
properties.description: A transformation to apply before painting the container.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate changes to properties.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating changes.
